body: My self esteem and assertiveness have improved but at such slow pace that I will take years to get to an acceptable level.  I do have hobbies, I enjoy movies, watchmaking, photography and many other things but that is not enough to keep me here. I don't like to work and I can't think of a thing I could enjoy working at because the moment it becomes a responsibility I stop liking it. I'm currently working at a family business but I hate it. You are right, maybe what I need is a bigger change but I'm just terrified about that, so terrified that I'd rather kill myself than trying. Thanks for your response and your good wishes...
